chunks: If it is said: Is it not true that his forefathers, peace be upon them, were visible and did not fear, nor did they reach a state where no one could reach them?

We said: The state of his forefathers, peace be upon them, is different from his state, because it was known from the state of his forefathers to the rulers of the time and others that they did not see themselves rising up against them, nor did they believe that they would rise with the sword and remove dynasties. Rather, it was known from their state that they were waiting for a Mahdi for themselves, and it did not harm the ruler if those who believed in their Imamate did so, as long as they were safe from them regarding their kingdom (and did not fear their side).

And such is not the case with the Master of the Time, peace be upon him, because it is known from him that he will rise with the sword, remove kingdoms, subdue every ruler, spread justice, and extinguish tyranny. From this of his characteristic, they fear his side and guard against his sudden attack, so they pursue him and keep watch, and place eyes on him, and pay attention to him out of fear of his leap and suspicion of his consolidation, so he fears at that time and needs concealment and manifestation, by hiding his person from everyone whom he does not trust, whether friend or enemy, until the time of his emergence.

Furthermore, his forefathers, peace be upon them, only appeared because it was known that if an incident occurred to them, there would be someone among their children to take his place and fill his position. And such is not the case with the Master of the Time, peace be upon him, because it is known that there is no one after him to take his place before the arrival of the time of his rising with the sword, therefore his concealment and occultation became necessary, and his state differed from the state of his forefathers, peace be upon them, and this is clear, praise to God.

If it is said: By what does he know the removal of fear at the time of his appearance? Is it through divine revelation? But the Imam is not revealed to, or through necessary knowledge? But that contradicts obligation, or through a sign that necessitates conjecture for him? Then in that is deception of the self.
ai.seo_question: Why is Imam Mahdi in occultation while previous Imams were visible?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi articulates the political theology of the Major Occultation by distinguishing between the passive, non-threatening presence of earlier Imams and the active, sovereign authority of Imam al-Mahdi, whose imminent military overthrow of tyrannies necessitates concealment to preserve his life. This discourse underscores the strategic wisdom of *ghayba* as a protective measure against rulers who, unlike those who tolerated previous Imams, fear the Mahdi's capacity to establish justice and eliminate injustice. The text further addresses the epistemological basis for his eventual reappearance, balancing divine knowledge with the practical necessity of avoiding premature exposure.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: If it is said: But is it not true that the forefathers of the Imam were alive and visible to people and despite this there was risk to their lives, but the circumstances of that time was not that people should have not access to them.

We would reply: The circumstances of the forefathers of Imam Mahdi (a.s) were different, because they acted according to dissimulation (Taqayyah) with the rulers of their times and acted with them in such a way that even the rulers knew that they would not stage an uprising and the Holy Imams (a.s) also did not see any exigency in staging an uprising. On the contrary, the circumstances of the lives of the Holy Imams (a.s) show that these personages were also in anticipation of the Mahdi and those who had faith in their Imamate also did not cause any loss to the regimes of their times [it was so, because the Holy Imams (a.s) were not commanded to stage an uprising]. But the matter of Imam Mahdi (a.s) is not like this. It is so, because it is known from the circumstances of the Imam that he would stage an armed uprising and finish off the tyrant regimes from the world and subdue all the tyrant rulers and wave the standard of justice and equity on the whole world and destroy injustice and oppression. Thus, if someone is having this quality then certainly the rulers of his time would be terrified and be inimical to him and would pursue him and send spies to observe all his movements; and they would be terrified of this all the time. In such circumstances, Imam (a.s) needs to keep himself away and in occultation from the people, till the time of his reappearance; from those from whom he perceives danger, whether they are friends or enemies.

In addition to what is mentioned, the forefathers of Imam Mahdi (a.s) were apparent and not in occultation, because if death or martyrdom occurred for them they knew well that after them one of their issues would be the successor, but such a thing is not there for Imam Mahdi (a.s). It is so, because if an event like martyrdom occurs before the uprising, there is no one who can be his successor; therefore it was necessary for Imam Mahdi (a.s) to be in occultation and circumstances of Imam (a.s) are completely different from those of his forefathers and this matter is absolutely clear.

If it is said: How can we understand that it is time of his reappearance and the danger to his life is no more? Can it be through divine revelation, whereas there is no revelation on Imam (a.s)? Or through definite knowledge, which does not require contemplation and consideration? It is also clear and obvious that it is opposed to religious duty. Or through Amara and a sign, which becomes a conjecture for him? It is also harmful to the life of the Imam and it casts his life into danger.
